questions.question: That steel pipe cannot be bent. It is _____.
questions.explanation: rigid = 堅硬的、不可彎曲的

questions.question: On the first page of a newspaper, we generally find _____.
questions.explanation: headlines = 頭條新聞，刊登於報紙頭版

questions.question: You can call for your new name tag in a couple of days. (call for = ?)
The compass needle will spin around when an airplane flies over the North Pole. (spin = ?)
The electrician performed his job well. (performed = ?)
The class may go on a picnic tomorrow. It _____ on the weather.
questions.explanation: depends on = 取決於（正確慣用語）

questions.question: The repair job was complex. (complex = ?)
Help me work out this math problem. (work out = ?)
A pharmacist is a _____.
He requested permission from the officer. (requested = ?)
A thermostat maintains and _____ the room temperature.
This is how it actually happened. (actually = ?)
Only people from the upper _____ of the company were there.
questions.explanation: echelon = 階層（軍事/組織用語）

questions.question: The animal died because it was underfed and _____.
The story should be condensed before publication. (condensed = ?)
The volcano emits smoke. (emits = ?)
When the continent was first discovered, there were vast tracts of unexplored _____.
The repairman checked the rotation of the fan. (rotation = ?)
What does it stand for? (stand for = ?)
Jack gave a definite answer to the question. His answer was _____.
The plane carried cargo. (cargo = ?)
If a wire has a rubber covering, it is _____.
People have known about magnets for many centuries. (centuries = ?)
They work _____ in the classroom.
questions.explanation: work 為動詞，後接副詞 well（修飾動詞）

questions.question: There is nothing but empty space above the atmosphere. This condition can be called _____.
questions.explanation: vacuum = 真空（大氣層外的空曠空間）

questions.question: Tom defends himself quite well by _____.
questions.explanation: defends = 防禦、保護自己，by fighting back 為合理搭配

questions.question: The recurrent bad weather does not _____ well for the timely completion of the stadium.
questions.explanation: augur well/ill for = 預示吉凶（固定用法）

questions.question: When you are against an idea, you _____.
The headlines are printed in _____.
questions.explanation: headlines = 頭條，以大字體（large type）印刷

questions.question: Most of our woodlands are natural forests. They are _____.
questions.explanation: natural forests = 天然林，非人工種植（not planted by man）
